node.statement: The spaces calU_e and breve-calU are compact. For epsilon_r <= e_quot^r <= 1/4, any U with U^dagger bold-dot U=J obeys (1-epsilon_r)||U||^2 <= 1. Moreover L_U is injective: if U bold-dot X=0, approximate associativity gives ||X|| <= epsilon_r||U||^2||X||, whose coefficient is at most epsilon_r/(1-epsilon_r)<1; finite dimensionality makes L_U surjective, so such U has a right inverse. Hence calU is exactly the closed zero locus of U mapsto U^dagger bold-dot U-J inside a bounded set, and is compact; its connected component calU_e is closed and compact. The continuous quotient of calU_e is compact.
